content.short: Manifold Finance is a block builder for Ethereum users and validators.
content.description: Manifold Finance serves as an intermediary between Ethereum users and validators and acts as a sophisticated block builder. By consolidating and ordering Ethereum transactions, it constructs blocks with the aim of delivering the highest return on investment for all stakeholders. In this process, it enables the creation of Maximal Extractable Value (MEV) by optimizing block composition for both users and validators across the Ethereum network. Founded in 2020 by Sam Bacha, Manifold Finance centers on efficient, ROI-driven MEV-enabled workflows for the Ethereum ecosystem.
